name: iRacing TCR Dash
author: Chris Indeherberge
description: For iRacing's TCR class, with a page for each session that follows your own class in multiclass races. Practice and qualifying are about lap times, with the last lap, the session best and the delta (and the class best in qualifying), plus fuel use; the race page has the gaps to the class cars ahead and behind, fuel use, the pit window and pit loss. RPM and speed in the centre, brake bias and ABS at the bottom right.
